title: Fix header + My Profile rendering by binding strictly to Firestore users/{uid} fields

requirements.text: Ensure the My Profile screen renders the logged-in user’s profile photo, full name, and email address by reading ONLY from Firestore document path `users/{auth.uid}` and binding ONLY to the existing Firestore field names `photoURL`, `name`, and `email` (no reads from Firebase Auth user fields for display).

quotes:
- Read user data ONLY from Firestore: users/{uid}
- Do NOT rename or mutate stored data
- Bind UI strictly to existing Firestore field names
...Fix ONLY:
  • ... My Profile page (photo, name, email)

acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated user navigates to `/profile`, the UI displays `users/{uid}.name` and `users/{uid}.email` values from Firestore.
When `users/{uid}.photoURL` is a non-empty string, the profile avatar image uses that URL (no Firebase Auth `photoURL` is used).
No Firestore writes occur as part of rendering My Profile (no mutation/rename/backfill of stored data).

requirements.text: On the My Profile screen, implement a deterministic avatar fallback based strictly on Firestore: if `users/{uid}.photoURL` is missing/empty/whitespace, do not render an image URL and instead render initials derived from `users/{uid}.name`.

quotes:
Expected Result:
... My Profile → shows actual saved full name, email, and photo

- Header → shows correct profile photo or initials

acceptanceCriteria: If `photoURL` is empty or whitespace, the AvatarImage is not attempted/used and the AvatarFallback shows initials derived from the Firestore `name`.
If Firestore `name` is present, initials are stable and derived from that value (not from Firebase Auth).

requirements.text: Fix the header’s top-right avatar and displayed header/profile-menu name so they render from Firestore `users/{uid}` only: use `photoURL` for the avatar image when present; otherwise show initials derived from Firestore `name`, and ensure the displayed name in the header/profile menu is exactly Firestore `name` (undo any incorrect name source/binding).

quotes:
• Header avatar is NOT rendering
• Header name was changed incorrectly without instruction
...
Fix ONLY:
  • Header avatar
  • Header name

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is logged in and `users/{uid}` exists, the header avatar uses Firestore `photoURL` if non-empty; otherwise shows initials derived from Firestore `name`.
The header/profile dropdown displays the user’s name from Firestore `users/{uid}.name` (no Firebase Auth display name/email is used for display).
No changes are made to routes/pages outside the header components and My Profile screen.

requirements.text: Verify the Firestore read is performed against the exact document path `users/{auth.uid}` with an awaited fresh server read (no cache) so UI reliably updates based on existing Firestore data; add/keep console logs sufficient to confirm the UID used and that the read is not from cache.

quotes:
Most likely causes:
...
3) Incorrect users/{uid} document path or missing await/subscribe

acceptanceCriteria: Browser console shows a log indicating a Firestore fetch for the current auth UID (e.g., includes the UID used).
The profile fetch uses a fresh server read (not a cached-only read), and logs demonstrate the read is not from cache.
Header and My Profile update to show Firestore-backed values after the profile query resolves (no permanent blank state when data exists).

constraints: Do not rename, migrate, or mutate any stored Firestore user data.
Read user profile display fields ONLY from Firestore `users/{uid}` (fields `name`, `email`, `photoURL`); do not display profile fields from Firebase Auth.
Do not touch any Admin dashboard/admin screens.
UI layout/design is acceptable; do not redesign or refactor unrelated UI.
nonGoals: Adding new profile fields or editing profile data.
Changing approval/role logic, routing, or guards beyond what is strictly required to render the header/profile data.
Introducing new pages, features, or refactors unrelated to header + My Profile rendering.
